Railway RRB JE CEN.No: 05/2026 Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) will release the notification for the RRB CEN 05/2026 recruitment of Junior Engineer JE, CMA & DMS posts on its official website. The online application process for RRB Junior Engineer JE Recruitment 2026 will start in July 2026 (Expected) & the candidates can apply until August 2026. Total of 4098 vacancies have been announced for Section Controller posts under RRB Junior Engineer JE CEN 05/2026 Recruitment. Candidates must check the Complete details for RRB Junior Engineer JE Recruitment 2026 given below.

  • Admit Card : Notify Soon

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
